After the discussion: why was it so hard to persuade anyone?

In class, nobody committed to donating. One student explained why: an individual cannot see any benefit from the donation right now, so the long-term arguments feel distant.

Businesses react the same way. Each reason asks the firm to spend money on something disconnected from how it competes, so CSR is seen as a cost and is the first thing cut when times are tight. The next slide shows why each reason falls short.
